data_objects.name: Grid-cell metadata
data_objects.meaning: A single-sheet workbook of grid-cell identifiers and associated latitude and longitude ranges, country labels, mean elevation values, named land-cover fields, and named climate-category fields. The worksheet dimension is 61,201 rows including the header and 68 columns.

data_objects.name: Monthly global gridded time series
data_objects.meaning: Six wide monthly tables, one for each filename-labelled quantity. Each has a Date column, 64,800 coordinate-labelled value columns, and 36 data rows under the header; the filenames indicate nominal coverage from 2021 through 2023 on a one-degree grid.

data_objects.name: Daily global gridded temperature
data_objects.meaning: A wide daily temperature-labelled table with a Date column, 64,800 coordinate-labelled value columns, and 365 data rows under the header; the filename indicates nominal coverage of 2023 on a one-degree grid.

data_objects.name: Ten-location daily temperature table
data_objects.meaning: A separate daily temperature-labelled table with Date and ten generically named series, Location_1 through Location_10, and 365 data rows under the header.

data_objects.name: Relief image collection
data_objects.meaning: A collection of 57,300 coordinate-labelled PNG relief images. Three inspected files were non-interlaced 8-bit RGB images with width 1,418 pixels and differing heights.

variables.name: ID
variables.meaning: Coordinate-like grid-cell identifier, exemplified by 84S_180W; its format corresponds to the coordinate labels used by the gridded CSV columns and relief filenames.

variables.name: Latitude range
variables.meaning: Textual numeric latitude interval associated with the grid-cell ID.

variables.name: Longitude range
variables.meaning: Textual numeric longitude interval associated with the grid-cell ID.

variables.name: Country
variables.meaning: Country or territory label associated with the grid cell.

variables.name: Mean elevation
variables.meaning: Numeric mean-elevation value associated with the grid cell.

variables.name: water through sparse_shrub (32 land-cover columns)
variables.meaning: A family of numeric fields, each named for a land-cover class such as water, snow_and_ice, grassland, cropland, tree cover, shrubland, urban, or bare areas.

variables.name: dry_steppe_hot_arid through mild_temperate_dry_winter_cool_summer (31 climate-category columns)
variables.meaning: A family of numeric fields named for climate categories, including dry, polar, tropical, mild-temperate, and snow categories.

variables.name: Date
variables.meaning: Temporal label for each monthly record in all six monthly files.

variables.name: coordinate-labelled value columns
variables.meaning: The 64,800 columns after Date are labelled by latitude and longitude tokens; observed header endpoints are 90S_180W and 89N_179W, consistent with a 180 by 360 one-degree global grid.

variables.name: lwd
variables.meaning: Monthly grid-cell value for the quantity abbreviated lwd in the filename.

variables.name: precipitation
variables.meaning: Monthly grid-cell precipitation-labelled value.

variables.name: pres
variables.meaning: Monthly grid-cell value for the quantity abbreviated pres in the filename.

variables.name: spechumidity
variables.meaning: Monthly grid-cell specific-humidity-labelled value.

variables.name: swd
variables.meaning: Monthly grid-cell value for the quantity abbreviated swd in the filename.

variables.name: temp
variables.meaning: Monthly grid-cell temperature-labelled value.

variables.name: Date
variables.meaning: Temporal label for each daily record.

variables.name: coordinate-labelled temperature columns
variables.meaning: The 64,800 columns after Date are temperature-labelled values indexed by the same observed coordinate-header endpoints as the monthly files.

variables.name: Date
variables.meaning: Temporal label for each daily record.

variables.name: Location_1 through Location_10
variables.meaning: Ten generically labelled daily temperature series; no coordinate or other location mapping is embedded in their column names.

variables.name: filename grid-cell identifier
variables.meaning: Coordinate-like identifier encoded between the relief_ prefix and .png suffix, such as 54S_8W.

variables.name: RGB pixel values
variables.meaning: Three 8-bit color channels forming each relief image.

variables.name: image width and height
variables.meaning: Raster dimensions; the three inspected images all had width 1,418 while their heights were 1,408, 2,436, and 7,782.

structure.description: All seven full gridded time-series CSVs have 64,801 columns: Date followed by 64,800 coordinate-labelled columns with matching observed first and last labels. The six monthly files each contain 36 records; the daily file contains 365 records.
The metadata worksheet is a 68-column wide table with 61,200 records under its header. ID is the candidate row key; uniqueness was not established by the bounded inspection.

Metadata IDs, gridded CSV column labels, and relief-image filename suffixes share the same latitude/longitude token pattern. Removing relief_ and .png yields a candidate alignment key, but the differing counts of metadata rows, time-series grid columns, and images show that identical coverage cannot be assumed.

Relief filenames contain 160 distinct latitude labels from 79S through 80N and 360 distinct longitude labels from 180W through 179E. The 57,300 files do not form a complete 160 by 360 rectangle. Sampled PNG heights vary, so a single common image shape is not established.

The top-level ten-location daily table has the same nominal year and daily record count as the full daily temperature table, but its generic Location_1 through Location_10 columns provide no grounded key for alignment to grid coordinates.

uncertainties: No embedded data dictionary or unit metadata was observed. Units remain unknown for mean elevation, temperature, precipitation, pres, spechumidity, lwd, and swd.
The exact expansions and physical definitions of the filename abbreviations lwd, swd, and pres are not established by the permitted evidence.
The scale and interpretation of the workbook's land-cover and climate-category numeric fields are not documented; they may be shares, indicators, or another encoding.
Date string formats, row ordering, missing-value encodings, and value dtypes in the CSV bodies were not established by the bounded inspection.
The uniqueness and complete coordinate coverage of workbook IDs were not verified, and cross-object coordinate coverage is not one-to-one by count.
The identities or coordinates represented by Location_1 through Location_10 are not supplied by their column names.
The relief images have no established pixel-value legend, geographic transform, spatial bounds, or reason for their varying heights in the inspected metadata.
annotation_notes: This semantic map uses only the declared public directory, with task, private, gold, grader, output, description, and existing-annotation material excluded.
Evidence was limited to directory inventory and counts, CSV headers and line counts, workbook sheet metadata with a bounded preview, and format metadata for three PNG files.
All paths are relative to the mosci-terra prepared/public root; the relief-image directory is referenced as a logical collection.
Null units are intentional where the public artifacts did not establish a unit.
